source.scopeLimit: Checks exact frozen source/archive bytes and test-name additions; production-diff semantic review and compiled-artifact audit are separate.

implementation.reverse: Lazy borrowed reverse page cursor locates the first logical tail once, then walks each slice backwards and visits the preceding page only on exhaustion. Valid nonzero nth_back resets the cursor for one direct relocation; original nth_back was already O(1). Shared remaining bounds keep forward/reverse consumption and hidden endpoint cells consistent.
implementation.resources: Only private temporary iterator fields changed. No persistent runtime/SharedDeque storage fields, heap allocations, public ABI/schema, Pine pivot rule, host dependency or cache policy added.
implementation.regressions: Six independent VecDeque reverse tests plus four public-runtime long-pivot tests cover ranges, Take/Skip, jumps, mixed direction/fold, checkpoint/shrink/regrowth, ZST and short-circuit resume; long sides, nearest NA, left equality versus strict right, Float signed-zero bits, dynamic lengths, same-site ordinary loops, forming replacement, failed update rollback, confirm and future commit.

iteratorLayoutEvidence.scope: Windows MSVC 64-bit compiler sizeof/align for included sealed baseline/current private types; temporary iterators grow, deque/storage fields remain unchanged; no allocation or ABI/release/cross-platform claim.

matrix.is_stochastic converts every value into a temporary Vec<f64> and computes columns even when rows already satisfy the OR predicate; source-level finding only, performance unmeasured.

limits: Offline native indicator evidence; requested System layout accounting not RSS; no TradingView parity, host/request/strategy performance, release or cross-platform throughput claim. Every case/stage median, range, paired direction and original raw timing/allocation is retained. Full raw profiles and public/typed payloads remain hashed ignored receipts rather than duplicate tracked documents. Warm block throughput only validates explicit initial/final snapshots, not each intermediate update.
